title: Wasteland Drifter
genre: Isometric Survival RPG (Cổ điển), Action-Adventure, Strategy.
setting: Thế giới tận thế năm 202X, khi xuất hiện đại dịch xác sống. Trái đất trở thành một vùng đất hoang tàn, khô khốc với những tàn tích rỉ sét của nền văn minh cũ. Con người co cụm trong các thành phố làm từ container. Nguồn nước sạch và đạn dược là thứ quý giá nhất. Những tháp radio cũ và các hầm ngầm quân sự là nơi ẩn chứa những bí mật về nguồn gốc virus.
coreLoop: Khám phá vùng đất hoang > Tiêu diệt Zombie để bảo vệ bản thân (Kills) > Thu thập nhu yếu phẩm và tiền cổ (Cash) > Giao dịch trang bị tại các khu định cư > Tuyển mộ người đồng hành (Followers) > Mở rộng tầm ảnh hưởng và tìm kiếm vùng đất an toàn hơn.
tone: U tối, gai góc (Gritty), tuyệt vọng nhưng xen lẫn sự mỉa mai (Black Humor). Hình ảnh chủ đạo là màu nâu của đất cát, màu xám của bê tông đổ nát và màu xanh neon mờ nhạt của các thiết bị điện tử cũ

structure.title: The Deserted Metro
structure.summary: In the war-torn urban remains, survivors struggle to stay alive amidst the chaos of zombies and dwindling resources. As the player, you endeavor to gather allies, accumulate supplies, and uncover the source of the outbreak.

chapters.title: The Awakening
chapters.description: The player's journey begins in a makeshift settlement where rumors of the ‘Crimson Virus’ origin spread. Gathering supplies and defeating local zombies reveals the presence of a mysterious cult advocating for creating a new world.

chapters.title: The Secrets of the Underground
chapters.description: Exploring abandoned subway stations leads to encounters with surviving factions. Players discover encrypted data containing information about the military's experiments that led to the outbreak.

chapters.title: Echoes of the Past
chapters.description: A massive radio tower holds a beacon for survivors. Players face a challenging boss, the ‘Undead Guardian,’ who was tasked to protect military secrets. Securing the tower opens up new quests and trading opportunities.

structure.title: The Cursed Forest
structure.summary: With the whispers of the forest guiding you, the second act introduces a mystical aspect. Players search for an ancient artifact rumored to halt the virus progression.

chapters.title: The Path of Shadows
chapters.description: Players navigate through haunted woods, where spirits of the past reveal clues to the artifact's location. They face spectral zombies that require strategic thinking to defeat.

chapters.title: The Collectors’ Duel
chapters.description: A confrontation with a rival faction, ‘The Collectors,’ ensues. Players must outsmart them in a series of challenges to gain crucial access to hidden parts of the ruins.

chapters.title: The Heart of the Forest
chapters.description: Reaching the shrine unlocks a powerful new ability linked with nature. Players must defend it from an overwhelming zombie horde, marking a climax in the quest for the artifact.

structure.title: The Steel Wastes
structure.summary: In the heart of industrial ruins, players must navigate competing settlements while uncovering how corporations exploited survivors in the chaos. Factions fight for control over the limited resources.

chapters.title: Conflict of Interests
chapters.description: Players enter a violent conflict zone controlled by antagonistic factions. Through skillful negotiation or combat, players gather intel on the corrupt dealings of former alliances.

chapters.title: The Underground Market
chapters.description: The black market allows players to acquire secret recipes for powerful weaponry. However, dealing with the criminal underworld requires cunning and strategy.

chapters.title: The Fall of Steel
chapters.description: Here, players face advanced monstrous zombies created through experimentation. Defeating the leader of the hoarded zombie army gives access to combat upgrades and lore about the corporation's downfall.

structure.title: The Frozen Abyss
structure.summary: A perilous journey into icy caves exposes players to new mutated threats. Here, alliances are tested, and the urgency to find ways to counter the primary virus escalates.

chapters.title: Beneath the Ice
chapters.description: Players unearth frozen zombies and secrets of previous survival attempts. The chilling environment creates new mechanics for survival, enhancing the urgency.

chapters.title: The Betrayal
chapters.description: Amidst alliance tensions, a betrayal occurs leading to significant losses. Players must rally remaining allies to fend off the ensuing carnage.

chapters.title: The Ancient Code
chapters.description: Upon reaching the citadel, players unlock historical archives revealing the virus's origin. They must face the ‘Frostborn Monarch,’ a terrifying zombie overlord guarding the secrets.

structure.title: The Radiant Bastion
structure.summary: In the final act, players gather their forces and knowledge to mount a last stand against the remnants of the virus and uncover the true enemy behind the apocalypse.

chapters.title: The Last Rally
chapters.description: Unite the factions from previous acts to prepare for the final confrontation. Players must strategically manage resources and allies.

chapters.title: The Revelation
chapters.description: Confronting the masterminds behind the virus leads to intense narrative revelations about hope, survival, and the burden of the past.

chapters.title: The Final Stand
chapters.description: A climactic battle ensues as players fight combined forces of zombies and corrupted enemies. Success or failure determines the fate of humanity, bringing closure and open-ended questions for future expansion.
